_comment: Plain-text source for the secure.config shipped to the warewolfserver-uat
Cloud test Function App by Dev/.azure/pipeline-CLOUD.yml.
The pipeline's Build stage encrypts this JSON with
Dev2.Services.Security.SecurityEncryption.Encrypt (the same AES-CBC routine
the Warewolf Studio uses) and writes the result to the publish output as
'secure.config'. SecureConfigLoader reads it from AppContext.BaseDirectory
at runtime; without it the engine has no effective permission map and
WorkflowAuthPolicyLoader denies every request with 503 ConfigMissing.
SecretKey is intentionally empty: SecureConfigLoader synthesises an
in-memory HMAC key when it is blank, so no secret is committed here.
Public is granted server-wide View+Execute so the public smoke-test
workflows exercised by the pipeline (Hello World, azure db) authorise and
execute through the anonymous /Public/ route.
Warewolf_ClientApps is the app-role granted to app-only client apps (e.g.
the AzureFunction / ServiceBus client examples' Managed Identities) by
Configure-WwExecutionAuth-Clients.ps1 -AppRolesToAssign. Its per-workflow
row below (IsServer=false, matched case-insensitively on ResourceName)
lets those clients View+Execute 'Hello World' via /secure/. The WindowsGroup
value must equal the sanitized Entra app-role value in the token's roles
claim; ResourceID is not used for matching, so it stays a zero GUID.
